description: This file contains hardware initialization code for the NXP Kinetis KW2XD SoC, including clock setup, oscillator configuration, and peripheral initialization routines.

methods.name: set_modem_clock
methods.description: Initializes GPIO pins and sets modem reset and GPIO5 pins for clock output.

methods.name: clock_init
methods.description: Configures the system clock by setting up the oscillator, PLL, and clock dividers.

methods.name: kw2xd_init
methods.description: Performs hardware initialization, including clock setup and releasing I/O power hold.
